start_here: Say to your AI: "Add an A record www to example.com on Hetzner, TTL 60, pointing at 203.0.113.10." It runs tool:set-a-hetzner-dns-rrset with the zone name.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads or changes your Hetzner DNS zones.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI what to do, with the zone name and the record values.
2. The AI calls tools:run with the tool and its input.
3. Read the answer; a change is real, so check it with tool:read-hetzner-dns-rrsets.

worked_examples.title: Create a record set in a Hetzner DNS zone
worked_examples.ask: Add an A record www to example.com on Hetzner, TTL 60, pointing at 203.0.113.10.
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/hetzner-dns/tool-rows.json: POST https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1/zones/{zone}/rrsets with the vault key hetzner-api-token as a bearer header, to api.hetzner.cloud only.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the new record set: name www, type A, TTL 60, one value 203.0.113.10.
